method: Single-reviewer visual reference by the AI assistant that implemented the detector, recorded before any tracker ran on these clips, from frames decoded by the app's own video element. Ball centres and radii are read in native video pixels from gridded views, with an uncertainty of roughly 5-20 native pixels (larger for the street clip). Spot checks are every third (or fourth/tenth) frame of the window at 10 Hz. A detection is correct if its centre is within 1.5 reference radii of the reference centre. Clips of kind decoy_no_ball and tiny_unverified test refusal and abstention; frames of ball_then_absent clips after the ball leaves the view are audited, not spot-checked.

clips.note: Beach-soccer penalty: a static orange ball on sand, a run-up, the kick (ball in flight, motion blur), then the ball in the net while the camera pans.
